text: Beep boop! Congratulations! You got admitted!
Welcome to the next chapter of your life.
I'm Sprout. Your brand new study buddy.
First year is a lot. New courses. New lecturers. So many notes.
Drop in your notes, your slides, even a photo of the board. I turn them into lessons, flashcards and quizzes.
Stuck on a word? Tap it. I'll run over and pull the answer up for you.
Can't focus? Start a ten minute sprint. I'll keep watch.
Earn XP. Keep your streak. And yes, you can dress me up!
Congratulations again. Start free today. SunrootLearn. Let's go!
